(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not include NaOH; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme that is not limited to VISCOZYME@.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that are not specifically limited to corn embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) in a manner that does not limit the storage conditions to stasis storage.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping that is not limited to PCR based genotyping.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype without limiting the selection criteria to those taught by Bullock. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated without limitation to the automation level described in Bullock.
